mainEntity.name: How much does a Range Rover Evoque TD4 engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A reconditioned Range Rover Evoque TD4 (DW12) engine typically costs between £2,000 and £3,500 for supply only, with fully rebuilt options ranging from £3,000 to £5,000.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of turbo or EGR failure in a Range Rover Evoque TD4?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most common early warning signs include a sudden loss of power, black smoke from the exhaust, or unexplained coolant loss without external leaks.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a Range Rover Evoque TD4?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if the body, chassis, and transmission are in sound condition. A £2,000-£3,500 reconditioned engine adds significant reliability and delivers 80,000-120,000 more miles.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Range Rover Evoque TD4 engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A professional supply and fit service for the Range Rover Evoque TD4 typically takes 2 to 3 days.

mainEntity.name: Can I upgrade my Range Rover Evoque TD4 to a 2.0L Ingenium diesel?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The engine mounts, wiring looms, ECU, fuel system, and exhaust are completely different between the 2.2L DW12 and the 2.0L Ingenium architectures.

historyTimeline.h2: Range Rover Evoque TD4 - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: When the TD4 variant launched in the first-generation L538 Range Rover Evoque, it provided a robust, fuel-efficient 2.2-litre PSA-sourced diesel option, establishing the blueprint for the model's early UK sales dominance and off-road capability.

milestones.description: DW12 (2.2L TD4 Diesel), 148hp, introduced with the Evoque L538 launch, featuring a robust bottom end, 16-valve head, and improved refinement over previous iterations.
Replaced by the 2.0L Ingenium diesel (AJ200D) alongside the Evoque facelift, concluding the original 2.2L TD4 production run after four years of service.

historyTimeline.closingNote: Every engine fitted to the Range Rover Evoque TD4 is covered below, with UK rebuilt pricing and known failure points for classic restorations and daily drivers.

commonProblems.h2: Range Rover Evoque TD4 Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The Range Rover Evoque TD4 (DW12) is generally a robust unit, but age-related issues like EGR cooler cracking and turbo actuator wear require proactive attention. Rebuilt engines through EnginesMarket include upgraded components addressing these original failure points, plus a minimum 12-month unlimited mileage warranty.

problems.h4: EGR Cooler & Turbo Actuator Failure - Why the Range Rover Evoque TD4 DW12 Loses Power
problems.rootCause: The electronic boost pressure actuator or its wiring harness corrodes, and the EGR cooler develops internal cracks, allowing coolant to leak and causing performance loss, black smoke, or potential hydrolock.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replacement of failed EGR cooler with updated part and boost actuator; coolant flush.
repairOptions.longevity: Viable if caught early before engine running issues or hydrolock occur.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, upgraded components addressing the original failure point, 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: Necessary if EGR failure has caused hydrolock or if turbo debris has contaminated the oil system.

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical Range Rover Evoque TD4 (2011-2015) currently holds a UK market value of approximately £4,000-£9,000 [THIRD-PARTY]. - Vehicle worth under ~£5,000: repair or used engine typically makes more sense than a full rebuilt unit. - Vehicle worth ~£5,000-£8,000: evaluate both; reconditioned is viable if keeping the car 2+ years. - Vehicle worth ~£8,000-£15,000: reconditioned/rebuilt usually justifies the premium via warranty and reliability. - Vehicle worth £15,000+: replacement cost is typically small relative to vehicle value. Given that most Range Rover Evoque TD4 models sit in the £4,000-£8,000 band, a verified low-mileage used DW12 or a reconditioned unit is often the most pragmatic financial choice over a full rebuild, provided the rest of the vehicle is in sound condition.
problems.recommendation: For the Range Rover Evoque TD4, preventative EGR and turbo actuator inspections are highly cost-effective. If catastrophic internal failure has occurred, a verified low-mileage used DW12 or a reconditioned unit with upgraded components is the most sensible route to preserve the vehicle's value.
